Newton mapped the seven spectral colors onto the seven degrees of the diatonic scale as follows: red-C, orange-D, yellow-E, green-F, blue-G, indigo-A, violet-B. Consequently the indigo arc (the range between green and blue) corresponds to the note A.

Yellow + blue produces green, so the queried range lies between green (G) and blue (A). That places the interval in question at the note A.

- red → D  
- orange → E  
- yellow → F  
- green → G  
- blue → A  
- indigo → B  
- violet → C  

“Yellow + blue” produces green, so the arc lying between green and blue on the wheel falls in the interval Newton assigned to the note A.

(The same mapping appears in Newton’s own diagram in Opticks, Book I, Part II, Proposition VI.)  
Thus the musical note that corresponds to that range is A.
